title: GRAS Self-Affirmation Overhaul
key_date_note: Proposed closure of the self-affirmed GRAS pathway with re-review of older additives
notes: Early review targets include BHA and BHT preservatives

title: Synthetic Dye Phase-Out
key_date_note: Voluntary phase-out of six petroleum dyes by end of 2026 with Red No. 3 moving faster
notes: A color swap is also a claims event not only a recipe change

citation: FDA and USDA joint UPF definition
title: Ultra-Processed Food Definition
key_date_note: No official definition yet; FDA and USDA jointly drafting one
notes: Watch item that will become a lever for warnings school bans and marketing pressure

title: Front-Of-Package Nutrition Labeling
key_date_note: Front box rating Saturated Fat Sodium and Added Sugars Low Medium or High
notes: Added sugar is the most likely High trigger on a sweetened drink

title: Healthy Claim Definition
key_date_note: Effective April 2025 and mandatory February 2028 using a food-group model
notes: Adding vitamins to an unhealthy base no longer qualifies for the claim

title: Caffeine Labeling Guidance
key_date_note: Voluntary federal caffeine-labeling guidance in progress
notes: Part of the caffeine and energy positioning track

title: California Food Safety Act Ingredient Ban
ingredients: Brominated Vegetable Oil;Potassium Bromate;Propylparaben;Red Dye No. 3
key_date_note: Bans four ingredients statewide with penalties up to 5000 then 10000 dollars
notes: BVO and Red No. 3 are the concrete near-term beverage items

title: California Date Label Standardization
key_date_note: Mandates the BEST if Used By and USE by family of terms and bans sell by
notes: A packaging-copy change not a formula change

title: California School Food Dye Ban
key_date_note: Bans six synthetic dyes from foods sold through school channels
notes: Applies to the school sales channel only

title: California School Ultra-Processed Food Law
key_date_note: CDPH defines terms by June 1 2028; names non-nutritive sweeteners
notes: Enacted school-focused UPF measure paired with the AB 2244 seal

title: California Non-Ultraprocessed Certified Seal
key_date_note: Introduced February 2026 as a voluntary certification with retailer good-faith effort
notes: Intended by California legislators as a national model

title: Proposition 65 Warning Requirement
key_date_note: Warning required when a listed chemical exceeds its safe-harbor level across roughly 1000 chemicals
notes: Bounty-driven with food notices above 1200 per year; defenses are testing and supplier indemnity

title: State Ingredient Restriction Patchwork
ingredients: Titanium Dioxide;Aspartame;BHA;BHT;Potassium Bromate;Propylparaben;Brominated Vegetable Oil;Carrageenan;High Fructose Corn Syrup
key_date_note: 140-plus bills across 42 states with 13 enacted and 100-plus ingredients targeted
notes: Aggregate watch row; split into per-state rows as individual bills are confirmed

title: State School Food Ingredient Laws
key_date_note: New laws in Iowa Nebraska and Tennessee with more proposed
notes: Promote to per-state rows as scope and dates are confirmed

title: State GRAS Reporting Bills
key_date_note: Active in California New Jersey and New York; would create state review bureaucracies
notes: Driven by the GRAS loophole narrative

title: SNAP Sweetened Beverage Restrictions
key_date_note: 23 states approved waivers with effective dates rolling out 2026 to 2028
notes: Broad wording may catch zero-sugar sparkling lines; needs a state-by-state product-list read

title: Canada Supplemented Foods Caution Statements
key_date_note: Cautionary statements and caffeine limits for supplemented foods
notes: Affects energy and functional beverage positioning

title: Mexico NOM-051 Front-Of-Pack Warning Labels
key_date_note: Black octagon seals for excess sugars calories and sweeteners plus a sweetener disclaimer
notes: Strict front-of-pack precedent; sweetener warning is relevant to beverages
